english_translations.sahih_international: Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muhammad], al-Kawthar.
english_translations.pickthall: Lo! We have given thee Abundance;
english_translations.yusuf_ali: To thee have We granted the Fount (of Abundance).
english_translations.shakir: Surely We have given you Kausar,
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), We have granted you abundant virtue.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Verily, We have granted you (O Muhammad (Peace be upon him)) Al-Kauthar (a river in Paradise);
english_translations.arberry: Surely We have given thee abundance;

ayahs.translation_bn: কাজেই তুমি তোমার প্রতিপালকের উদ্দেশ্যে নামায আদায় কর এবং কুরবানী কর,
ayahs.translation_en: So pray to your Lord and sacrifice [to Him alone].
ayahs.conventional_en: So pray to your Lord and sacrifice [to Him alone].

ayahs.meta_bn: সালাত ও কোরবানির আত্মনিবেদন: স্বীয় প্রতিপালকের উদ্দেশ্যে সালাত আদায় ও কোরবানি

english_translations.sahih_international: So pray to your Lord and sacrifice [to Him alone].
english_translations.pickthall: So pray unto thy Lord, and sacrifice.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Therefore to thy Lord turn in Prayer and Sacrifice.
english_translations.shakir: Therefore pray to your Lord and make a sacrifice.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: So worship your Lord and make sacrificial offerings.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Therefore turn in prayer to your Lord and sacrifice (to Him only).
english_translations.arberry: so pray unto thy Lord and sacrifice.

ayahs.translation_bn: (তোমার নাম-চিহ্ন কোন দিন মুছবে না, বরং) তোমার প্রতি বিদ্বেষ পোষণকারীরাই নাম চিহ্নহীন- নির্মূল।
ayahs.translation_en: Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off.
ayahs.conventional_en: Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off.
ayahs.conventional_bn: (তোমার নাম-চিহ্ন কোন দিন মুছবে না, বরং) তোমার প্রতি বিদ্বেষ পোষণকারীরাই নাম চিহ্নহীন- নির্মূল।

english_translations.sahih_international: Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off.
english_translations.pickthall: Lo! it is thy insulter (and not thou) who is without posterity.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: For he who hateth thee, he will be cut off (from Future Hope).
english_translations.shakir: Surely your enemy is the one who shall be without posterity,
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Whoever hates you will himself remain childless.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: For he who makes you angry (O Muhammad (Peace be upon him)), - he will be cut off (from every good thing in this world and in the Hereafter).
english_translations.arberry: Surely he that hates thee, he is the one cut off.
